about_the_game:
• Real-time action combat: Feel the heat of fast-paced top-down combat that involves a mix of tactical positioning, use of powerful abilities, quick reflexes, and coordinated team play to outsmart opponents. Your strategy, your victory.
  • Player vs Player: Put your team to the ultimate test by engaging in exciting battles against other players whether you're facing off in the open world or in dedicated battle arenas.


  • Unique Creatures: Capture a wide variety of Spherix, each defined by their own element, role and abilities. Assemble a team of up to 4 Spherix, discover ideal synergies for your individual playstyle and find the perfect team setup for any challenge.
  • Grow & Fuse: Battle, level up, evolve, and fuse your Spherix to unlock new abilities and perks, expanding your range of build options.
  • Enhance & equip: Empower your Spherix by equipping items that boost their attributes. These Items can also be enhanced to unleash their full potential.


  • Open world: Explore the world of Trinia where you can complete quests, events, collect resources and solve puzzles.
  • Multiplayer online: Change the course of your journey with other players where cooperation, competition, and community shape your experience.
  • Dungeons: Unveil the echos of the past and experience handcrafted and randomly generated dungeons that feature unique events, enemies, bosses and loot.

Planned Key features

  • Ranked PvP:
    • Seasons
    • Solo and premade queue
    • Special rewards
  • Endless dungeon mode:
    • Endgame challenge
    • Scaling difficulty and rewards
  • Economy:
    • Player driven
    • Marketplace

    Other Planned Features

    • Improved evolving and dynamic open world.
    • Spherix riding.
    • Character Personalization.

short_description: Spherix combines creature collection with thrilling real-time action combat in a vibrant multiplayer online open world. Capture, battle, evolve and customize your Spherix. Explore dungeons, complete quests, unveil mysteries and build the most powerful team. A new adventure awaits. Are you ready?
